title: Untrained MaleCNS - Front Nine, round 12
description: The wild fly's round seed 12, one of ten (seeds 7-16): the same connectome simulation, read out by fixed rules written before any shot was seen. It has never had a lesson: the comparison for the trained rounds.

controller.label: MaleCNS LIVE
controller.description: Simulated LIF dynamics over every retained MaleCNS v1.0 neuron and edge. Proxy sensory injection and engineered motor readout (see docs/SENSORY_MAPPING.md, docs/MOTOR_MAPPING.md).

notes: trajectory samples rounded to 4 decimals (0.1 mm, 0.1 ms) for size; the source run re-simulates bit for bit with `fly-golf replay 20260914T231400Z-055388`
